note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Upscale shows relief/emboss shading and thin straight vertical hairlines at the same x-positions as every other unit (about 75px and 170px in the 1:1 crop). Reads as a ruled seam or stamp, not grain.
flags.fix: Remove the fixed-column hairlines (check the flipbook seed/grain injection for a column-aligned pattern). Lower the emboss/relief contrast toward the original's flat speckle.

flags.problem: Same fixed-column vertical hairlines and emboss look as the rest of the set; the 1:1 crop looks relief-shaded rather than like the original's speckled grey.
flags.fix: Remove the column-aligned hairlines and reduce the relief shading so the grain stays flat, matching the original tone.

flags.problem: Fixed-column vertical hairlines run the full height at 1:1, and the surface is embossed-looking rather than matching the original's speckle.
flags.fix: Remove the column-aligned hairlines; soften the emboss so the grain reads as the original's sand speckle.

flags.problem: Vertical hairlines at fixed columns in the 1:1 crop, plus embossed relief highlights that read as plastic rather than the original's flat speckle.
flags.fix: Strip the column-aligned hairlines and reduce relief/emboss intensity toward the original's tonal range.

flags.problem: Fixed-column hairlines visible at 1:1 and an embossed, bumpy look that departs from the original's flat grey speckle.
flags.fix: Remove the column-aligned hairlines and flatten the emboss so the material matches the original.

flags.problem: Fixed-column hairlines plus relief highlights that do not match the original's flat grey speckle.
flags.fix: Strip the column-aligned hairlines and reduce relief/emboss contrast.
